measured.bundling: esbuild, minified, format esm, platform neutral, conditions source/workerd/worker/browser/import, cloudflare:* and node:* external; gzip -9

crossings.note: RPC calls per request, script <-> runtime Worker, counted in Node with the same modules (first request per script, so including the one-off slice fetch)

latency.harness: local workerd via Miniflare (packages/linker-packed/src/local.ts), loopback client wall time; cold = first request on a fresh instance (7 instances each for read and write); warm = 100 requests per target with all targets served at once and requests interleaved across them, after 5 warm-up pairs; pairedVsPerEntryPoint = median of request-by-request differences; read GET /v1/customers/{id}, write POST /v1/customers, plus POST /v1/orders/{order}/submit (2 js units, 1 transition)
